Title: Admin edits an existing group address and the change is saved
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Group Addresses and the table shows the columns Identifier, Address 1 and Edit.

Step Action: Select the Edit link on the first row of the table.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Edit Group Address and the form is filled with the saved values of that group address.

Step Action: Note the current value of Packing Instructions as <original packing instructions> and the Identifier of the record.
Step Expected: The original Packing Instructions value and the Identifier are recorded for later steps.

Step Action: Replace the Packing Instructions value with E2E packing note <run id>.
Step Expected: The Packing Instructions field shows E2E packing note <run id>.

Step Action: Select Save.
Step Expected: The page returns to Group Addresses and the h1 reads Group Addresses.

Step Action: Select Edit on the row with the same Identifier.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Edit Group Address and Packing Instructions shows E2E packing note <run id>.

Step Action: Cleanup: replace the Packing Instructions value with <original packing instructions> and select Save.
Step Expected: The page returns to Group Addresses and the record holds its original Packing Instructions again.

Title: Admin cancels an edit of a group address and nothing changes
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Group Addresses.

Step Action: Select the Edit link on the first row of the table.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Edit Group Address.

Step Action: Note the current value of Packing Instructions as <original packing instructions> and the Identifier of the record.
Step Expected: The original value and the Identifier are recorded.

Step Action: Replace the Packing Instructions value with E2E cancelled note <run id>.
Step Expected: The Packing Instructions field shows E2E cancelled note <run id>.

Step Action: Select Cancel.
Step Expected: The page leaves Edit Group Address without showing a server error page.

Step Action: Open the Edit link for the row with the same Identifier on Group Addresses.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Edit Group Address and Packing Instructions shows <original packing instructions>, not E2E cancelled note <run id>.

Step Action: Cleanup: select Cancel to leave the form.
Step Expected: The form closes and no data has been changed.

Title: Required fields block saving a new group address
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Group Addresses.

Step Action: Select the Create Group Address link.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Create Group Address and every field is empty.

Step Action: Leave every field empty and select Save.
Step Expected: The page stays on Create Group Address and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Look at the validation next to Identifier.
Step Expected: A validation marker whose text starts An identifier m is shown.

Step Action: Look at the validation next to Address 1 and Address 2.
Step Expected: A validation marker whose text starts At least two Ad is shown for Address 1 and for Address 2.

Step Action: Look at the validation next to Country.
Step Expected: A validation marker whose text starts The Country for is shown.

Step Action: Cleanup: select Cancel and open the Group Addresses list.
Step Expected: The list shows no new row, because nothing was saved.

Title: Admin creates a new group address and it is listed
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Group Addresses.

Step Action: Select the Create Group Address link.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Create Group Address.

Step Action: Enter E2E-<run id> in Identifier, 1 Test Street in Address 1 and Testtown in Address 2.
Step Expected: The three fields show the entered values.

Step Action: Choose <any listed country> in Country.
Step Expected: The Country field shows the chosen country.

Step Action: Select Save.
Step Expected: The page returns to Group Addresses and the h1 reads Group Addresses.

Step Action: Look for the identifier E2E-<run id> in the table.
Step Expected: A row with Identifier E2E-<run id> and Address 1 1 Test Street is listed.

Step Action: Cleanup: ask the environment owner to reset the database, because the UI offers no Delete.
Step Expected: The group address E2E-<run id> is no longer present after the reset.

Title: Admin changes the Telephone of a group address and restores it
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Group Addresses.

Step Action: Select the Edit link on the first row of the table.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Edit Group Address.

Step Action: Note the current value of Telephone as <original telephone> and the Identifier of the record.
Step Expected: The original Telephone and the Identifier are recorded.

Step Action: Replace the Telephone value with <synthetic telephone number> and select Save.
Step Expected: The page returns to Group Addresses.

Step Action: Select Edit on the row with the same Identifier.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Edit Group Address and Telephone shows <synthetic telephone number>.

Step Action: Cleanup: replace the Telephone value with <original telephone>.
Step Expected: The Telephone field shows <original telephone>.

Step Action: Select Save.
Step Expected: The page returns to Group Addresses and the record holds its original Telephone again.
